# AI Workspace

This repository is used to design, test, and standardize AI-assisted workflows for software delivery.

## Purpose
This workspace helps teams:
- create reusable AI prompts
- define standards and playbooks
- generate design docs, test cases, audits, and evaluation artifacts
- organize AI-generated work in a clean and repeatable way

## Key Areas
- `.github/prompts/` → runnable Copilot prompts
- `docs/standards/` → rules and conventions
- `docs/playbooks/` → step-by-step team guides
- `.github/skills/` → task-specific execution methods
- `templates/` → output formats
- `artifacts/` → generated working deliverables
- `reports/` → final report outputs
